metadata.description: Official marketplace for DorkOS — plugins, skill packs and shapes

plugins.name: marketplace-dev
plugins.description: Guides AI agents through developing, validating, and publishing DorkOS marketplace packages

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: The /flow workflow engine: a PM-agnostic, dual-mode (manual and autonomous) system that carries product work from capture to done across one stage spine, with a runnable-TypeScript engine and a pluggable tracker adapter.

plugins.name: linear-ops
plugins.description: Your Linear issues on the dashboard. After you approve its schedule, the agent checks your Linear inbox every 15 minutes.

plugins.name: writing-pack
plugins.description: Four skills for writing that people and agents can use: plain-language user copy, architecture decision records, developer guides, and clarifying questions before work starts

plugins.name: safety-hooks
plugins.description: Three guards that stop an agent's shell commands from destroying work: no stash or discarding checkout, no killing processes by name, and no reading or writing files your settings deny

plugins.name: ephemeral-infra
plugins.description: Label throwaway containers, VMs and sandboxes, and sweep them from the next run: exit handlers do not survive a kill

plugins.name: visual-companion
plugins.description: Your agent shows you screens, mockups and clickable prototypes beside the chat. Pin a note on the exact spot you want changed, press Send, and it gets to work. It runs on this computer only, with no share or guest links. Any page this renders can message the agent that owns it. Don't open pages you don't trust.
